requirements.text: 4 or more years of experience building production software, with deep expertise in frontend development and experience working across the stack
Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript, modern JavaScript, and frontend tooling
Experience building or integrating with APIs, backend services, and production data systems
Deep understanding of responsive design, browser performance, accessibility, and maintainable UI architecture
A strong sense of ownership. You take responsibility for the quality, delivery, and impact of your work
A highly proactive working style. You identify what needs to happen next and move it forward without waiting for detailed direction
A bias for action. You make thoughtful, pragmatic tradeoffs and maintain momentum in ambiguous situations
Strong product judgment and the ability to turn loosely defined customer problems into concrete solutions
A customer obsessed mindset. You engage with users, understand their workflows, and translate their pain points into product improvements
The ability to operate independently while collaborating closely with a fast moving team
A habit of communicating progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly and early
High standards for quality without allowing perfectionism to prevent shipping
Comfort working in an environment where feedback comes directly from production users and enterprise partners
Located in, or willing to relocate to, San Francisco
